fusions.name: Skewer from Afar
fusions.desc: A thrown point that deals 36 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Skewering Toss
fusions.desc: Throws a point that deals 5 damage, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Stretch the Line
fusions.desc: For 12 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Door-Facing Instinct
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 10%. It also regenerates 0.3 health a second, permanently.
